scores.label: A
scores.note: 'general people' and 'standard people' are unidiomatic; 'unremarkable' adds a pejorative tone; 'usual people' shifts meaning to 'the people usually involved'; 'non-extraordinary' is an odd coinage; 1-5 are plain near-synonyms

scores.label: B
scores.note: 'run-of-the-mill' is casual and pejorative for the essay; 'conventional people' is the wrong sense (traditional-minded); best option 'everyday' is buried last

scores.label: C
scores.note: 'commonplace' describes things not people; 'every people' is ungrammatical; 'day-to-day people' is unidiomatic; 'regular citizens' in place gives 'regular citizens people', ungrammatical
